capabilities: Turn PDFs, slides, documents and images into notes, Mermaid mind maps and Question::Answer flashcards, with AI or by hand
Create and convert Word assignments in a MUNI ARTS-style template and tick off submitted deadlines
Back up the vault automatically to OneDrive, Google Drive, Dropbox, iCloud or another location, keeping chosen versions
Show a Home dashboard with deadlines, courses, a material queue and weekly overviews
Integrate with the Neuro Roadmap planner and verify the system after its updates
disambiguation: Not a general second-brain PKM system; it is a study workflow tailored to the KISK programme at Masaryk University, with Czech folder names and MUNI ARTS conventions.
extras: macOS only (scripts, backup and AI buttons need macOS; on mobile Obsidian only shows the notes); needs Obsidian 1.9+ (built-in Bases); unofficial student project, not a product of Masaryk University; the detailed user guide is installed as a note (01 Návod) in the vault; no telemetry, ads, accounts or payments.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in workflow for turning course PDFs and slides into study notes, flashcards and deadline-tracked university assignments.

relations.evidence: Works with Neuro Roadmap (a planner by Matteo Rossi – Gantt, Horizon, calendar)
Claude Code (recommended) | Claude Code + a Claude subscription | best results
optional Spaced Repetition | in Obsidian: Community plugins → Browse | flashcard review

summary: Study system for KISK students at Masaryk University that turns course materials into notes, flashcards and Word assignments, with or without AI.
